name: AECi — Linear reconciliation: persistent stuck requests
message:
A vendor request has been stuck for >~1h and is still failing Linear issue creation (AECI-214 / Phase 6.7). `aeci.linear.reconcile.persistent_failure` is emitted by the every-15-min reconciliation sweep (`lib/reconciliation-sweep.ts`) when an `open` `vendor_requests` row with `linear_issue_id=null` is older than the persistent threshold AND a fresh retry of §6.4 still failed. The request is NOT lost — it's visible in /admin/requests and retried every 15 min — but the Linear assignee was never notified, so it needs a human. This is the §6.2 backstop alert: until Loops lands (Phase 7), the admin-email seam is a fail-open no-op (`aeci.linear.reconcile.email{outcome:skipped}`), so THIS alert + the /admin/requests queue ARE the notification. First checks: read `service:aeci-api source:reconcile` error logs for the stuck `request_ids`; pivot `aeci.linear.issue{outcome:failed}` by `reason` (`http_error 401/403` → LINEAR_API_KEY missing/revoked; `graphql_error` → drifted board ids in `lib/linear.ts`; `timeout`/`network` → Linear down; `db_error` → link-back write failed). `aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck` is the live backlog size. Fix the root cause and the next 15-min sweep self-heals (the retry is idempotent — never double-creates).

Note: deliberately NO notify_no_data — `persistent_failure` is emitted only when the failure condition holds (like `aeci.perspective.api`), so zero points is the healthy state and a no-data alert would be constant noise. Sweep-liveness (a no-data check on the always-emitted `aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck` gauge) lands with the Phase-6 dashboard (6.12). The >~1h persistent threshold + the 15-min cadence are launch-tunable (constants in `lib/reconciliation-sweep.ts`).

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#linear-reconciliation--stuck-requests
